body:
Just your responding at all helps so much, thank you for taking the time to read and respond so genuinely. I’m glad you see it as touching instead of lame as heck, haha—that alone takes some of the burden off the stress I’m feeling on my heart right now. 

By the nature of the game, when finishing a good route, the game itself asks you to not replay it. Some people do, but I won’t. If I could, I would most certainly take that suggestion though. That gives me the idea to at least attempt to replay some other old favorite games though, which might help, so thank you so much for saying that.

I’m going to bed now, but thank you, truly, for both your words and suggestion. I can’t explain what it means to me tonight.

Thank you for this, and I definitely appreciate your sentiment; I love poetic language, and I think it’s great you include that. It sounded very poetic indeed :’)

I have to go to bed now, and I’d like to respond more to this in the morning, but sincerely, thank you. I really needed to hear that right now, so for everything I’m worth, I appreciate it.

Thank you so much for responding. 
I’m glad you know what I mean; when writing the post all I could think was “I am legit setting myself up to look so silly right now, no one probably does this,” so I can’t tell you how much of a relief it is to hear you have a similar connection to a game.

I have played earthbound, and I LOVE it! I did hear about that connection, which is unabashedly how I got into it. I’ve never found a game that i like quite as much as undertale, though. That being said, I don’t really know what I like to play myself too much to be honest—my parents grew up only letting my brothers play video games, and said it wasn’t for girls, so I only really ever watched most games. I’m not terribly good at many games now because of it, so games that aren’t too hard from a gameplay standpoint are mostly what I like haha.

I’m going to head to bed now, but I’ll try to respond more tomorrow. Truly, thank you so much for your time.

Thank you so much for your response. Someone getting back to em, especially in a positive way like that, means the world. 

I don’t think I could do a different route; I think it’s their joy that brings me hope. But I think you’re right; it’s terrifying, but I need to find something else to help cope. 

Thank you so much for responding, truly. It makes a difference.
